title: [Job Queue] Clearer message and attempt number for runs interrupted by the platform
summary: Job Queue displays a clearer message when the platform interrupts a run, including the attempt number, and adds telemetry tracking for interruptions.
key_points: Replaces confusing 'job has stopped' error message with 'run was interrupted' message that includes the attempt number
Derives attempt number from log entries sharing the same System Task Id
Adds JobQueueInterruptedAttempt dimension to the 0000PCR telemetry signal
Helps distinguish platform interruptions from actual job failures
User-facing label text changes require retranslation and updates to any monitoring rules
quote: Replaces the message with: "This run (attempt N) was interrupted because the service restarted or was updated."
